correctness.rationale: For p<q, gcd(pq,φ(pq))>1 iff p|(q−1). Fixing p∤m and unit residue gives one reduced CRT class for q modulo mp with coefficient 1/(φ(m)p(p−1)); nonunits force q|m hence only small exceptions. For p|m, q simultaneously ≡1 mod p and ≡c/p mod m/p, compatible iff c/p≡1 mod gcd(p,m/p), and reduced iff gcd(c/p,m/p)=1; leading coefficient 1/[pφ(lcm(p,m/p))]. Fixed-p PNT in AP supplies main terms. For p∈(Y,X^(1/3)], Brun–Titchmarsh at X/p and modulus mp gives O_m(X/(p(p−1)log X)), with tail O_m(1/Y); p>X^(1/3) contribute O(X^(2/3)) by q=1+kp. Hence summation interchange is valid. Exact support and cutoff follow from all large pairs needing q>m. Independent bounded integer enumerations confirm forbidden-class implications for m≤40 but do not establish the asymptotic.
